column2: -2.2707376737386435 The Discovery of Our Lady's Well https://wyrd.wiki/europe/england/gloucestershire/the-discovery-of-our-lady-s-well According to local tradition
column3: the Virgin Mary discovered the ancient spring after her boat was washed ashore by the Severn Bore during a journey to visit Joseph of Arimathea at Glastonbury. The well's waters were historically sought for their miraculous healing properties and pilgrimage cures. #holy-well
